name: glossy_lobes
source: glossy_lobes, authored as 11 control points as the albedo of the glossy_lobes style: deep navy through slate blue (the reference's cool pixels by lightness decile) crossing a dark olive into old gold (its warm pixels), ending in a warm orange for the star cores, each stop a little more saturated than the reference's means; the gold stops sit near the reference's top warm deciles rather than below them, since the tone pass pins the median and a frame with navy gaps otherwise reads p90 low.
